result_text:
I fixed the four default scoping conventions so they match the files they were meant for. The full `codeanalyzer` suite passes with no failures, including a new test I added for these rules.

Changes in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`:

- **HTML generated pages:** the three pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules now use `.*[.](htm|html|xhtml)` instead of `(html|html|xhtml)`. Plain `.htm` pages are covered now.
- **.NET doc XML:** `.*/[.]xml` became `.*[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches.
- **JavaScript "Generated by":** `.*/[.]js` became `.*[.]js`, so `app.js` matches.
- **Gradle JavaScript:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` became `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

I also added `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java`. It checks that the `.htm`, `.html` and `.xhtml` pages, the `<doc>` XML file, the `// Generated by` JavaScript file and `build-gradle.js` land in the expected scope. It also checks that a hand-written `.htm`, `.xml`, `.js` and `build.gradle` (which the existing `.*[.]gradle` rule still covers) stay out of the wrong scopes. I did not run a test against the unfixed code to confirm it fails there.

Nothing is committed.
